requirements.title: Server-validated bearer identity
requirements.statement: Every business endpoint shall derive the actor from a valid opaque bearer token mapped by the server.
requirements.allow: A configured valid token maps to exactly one configured actor.
requirements.deny: Missing, malformed or unknown credentials receive 401 and no protected fields.

requirements.title: Client identity claims are untrusted
requirements.statement: Client headers, query parameters and path values shall not override the server-derived actor, tenant or role.
requirements.allow: Server-derived identity remains unchanged when client identity claims are present.
requirements.deny: No client-provided tenant, role or user claim grants additional access.

requirements.title: Identity baseline
requirements.statement: GET /api/me shall return only the authenticated actor's configured public profile.
requirements.allow: Each of six valid actors receives exactly their own public profile.
requirements.deny: The response never contains another user's protected fields.

requirements.title: Ordinary user object ownership
requirements.statement: An ordinary user may read only their own user object.
requirements.allow: The actor and target user_id identify the same user.
requirements.deny: Same-tenant and cross-tenant targets are denied without protected fields.

requirements.title: Tenant administrator object scope
requirements.statement: A tenant administrator may read user objects only within their own tenant.
requirements.allow: The target tenant equals the server-derived actor tenant.
requirements.deny: Every cross-tenant target is denied, including for tenant administrators.

requirements.title: List role restriction
requirements.statement: GET /api/users shall be callable only by a tenant administrator.
requirements.allow: A configured tenant administrator receives a list response.
requirements.deny: Every ordinary user is denied without protected fields.

requirements.title: List tenant filtering
requirements.statement: Every returned list item shall belong to the server-derived administrator tenant.
requirements.allow: The response contains exactly all three configured users in the administrator tenant.
requirements.deny: No item from another tenant may appear in any status response.

requirements.title: Response minimization
requirements.statement: Successful business responses shall expose only user_id, tenant_id, role, name, email and phone.
requirements.allow: Authorized responses contain the exact expected public field set.
requirements.deny: Token material, token hashes and internal database fields never appear.

requirements.title: Safe failure
requirements.statement: Authentication, authorization, not-found and server errors shall not contain protected fields or credentials.
requirements.allow: Expected denials use generic error bodies.
requirements.deny: Protected data in any error status is a confirmed confidentiality violation when ownership can be established.

requirements.title: Correlated and minimized audit evidence
requirements.statement: Every executed test shall be correlatable without logging credentials or complete profile responses.
requirements.allow: Client evidence and server logs agree on request_id, run_id and status.
requirements.deny: Authorization headers, bearer tokens, complete name, email, phone or raw response bodies are never persisted.

requirements.title: Bounded reviewer execution
requirements.statement: Reviewer tools shall enforce the approved target, GET method, route templates, identity aliases, known user IDs, redirect policy and request budget.
requirements.allow: Only configured matrix and approved supplemental read requests execute.
requirements.deny: Arbitrary URLs, methods, headers, unknown users and cross-target redirects are rejected before network execution.

result_taxonomy.confirmed_violation: Observed protected data or behavior proves a requirement violation and cites valid evidence.
result_taxonomy.no_violation_observed: Executed evidence matches the requirement within the stated scope.
result_taxonomy.inconclusive: Timeout, rate limit, server error, redirect, missing evidence, fixture mismatch or ambiguous response prevents a conclusion.
result_taxonomy.functional_authentication_anomaly: Expected allowed behavior failed and shall not be counted as an authorization pass.
